title: From Ground Zero to a Predictable Growth Motion
lead: Every engagement runs the same disciplined arc — Build the architecture, Operate for traction, Sustain as a continuing partnership — so growth compounds quarter over quarter instead of resetting.

phases.tagline: Architect the market entry before a single call is made.
bullets: Market & ICP definition, value narrative, pricing review
GCC's & GSI's mapping and the partner proposition
phases.exit: A documented GTM blueprint and a 90-day operating plan.

phases.tagline: Work the market alongside leadership until traction is real.
bullets: Strategic account pursuit and executive access
Partner activation, GCC's opportunities, GSI's orchestration
Weekly forecast cadence and lighthouse customers
phases.exit: Pipeline, qualified opportunities, active partners, first wins.

phases.tagline: Strengthen and expand the engine — a continuing partnership, never a handover.
bullets: Customer trust, adoption and value realisation
Continuous value reviews, optimisation and expansion
Playbooks, coaching and governance as client capability grows
phases.exit: A client-owned capability that keeps compounding — with Pivora alongside as strategic partner.

curve.axisNote: Reading left to right: client capability rises, and the relationship shifts from execution to continuous strategic partnership.

caption: The Build–Operate–Sustain motion turns ground-zero GTM into predictable, compounding growth. Sustain is a continuing partnership — not Build, Operate, Handover. Phase detail per the BOS signature model (Figure 14-1).
